stem.text: In the reaction shown, the concentrations of both X and Y are reduced to half of their original values whilst keeping the total volume of the solution constant.
Simultaneously the temperature is increased from $298\,\text{K}$ to $348\,\text{K}$.

A.text: A smaller proportion of collisions between particles of X and particles of Y will be successful.

B.text: The average kinetic energy of particles of X and particles of Y will increase.

C.text: The rate of the reaction will be unaffected.

D.text: The frequency of collisions between particles of X and particles of Y will halve.
